answer: Each agent commits a 64 GB RAM array and a peer-issued micro-benchmark endpoint, then finishes a task under a 2 second deadline that blocks GPU time-sharing across clones. One honest agent runs 1 endpoint for a 500 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 endpoints and 10 RAM arrays, so cost scales 10X. Verifiers check the ripple of latency samples, require an echo of the nonce signed by the key, and let a raven auditor re-execute 5 percent of runs. Bad timing or a missing echo slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders.
